open_questions: API Group II confirmed from an additional official Petro-Canada manufacturer brochure; the original DL2-10020.pdf did not explicitly assign a grade-specific group.

Viscosity index remains unreported for PURITY L45. Grade-specific CCS remains Missing: the CCS values previously recorded here at -20°C, -25°C, -30°C and -35°C belong to PURITY 1020, not L45; the manufacturer's March 2023 brochure prints no CCS for L45 (see the 'CCS (2026-10 audit)' note).
Grade-specific SDS and differences between brochure editions require reconciliation.

CCS (2026-10 audit): the 4 CCS values previously recorded here - 935 mPa.s at -20 °C, 1716 mPa.s at -25 °C, 3438 mPa.s at -30 °C, 7415 mPa.s at -35 °C (Reported, Typical, ASTM D5293; cited to https://petrocanadalubricants.com/-/media/pdfs/brochures/purity/purity-base-oil_lub3213e.ashx, revision 2023-03, no page) - are the PURITY 1020 column of Petro-Canada's 'Typical Properties of PURITY Base Oils' table in LUB3213E / IM-1809E (2023.03) p.2, not PURITY L45. The same values appear under PURITY 1020 in LUB3213E (2015.07) = DL2-10020.pdf p.2. The L35-L65 table in both editions has no Cold Crank Simulator row, so no CCS value is published for PURITY L45; ccs is now Missing. The values were not copied to any other record. Confirm with Petro-Canada whether a CCS value exists for PURITY L45.
